Upwards Arrow Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Upwards Arrow is 24. Hold Alt, type 24 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Upwards Arrow also has the Unicode codepoint U+2191, so you can type it with Alt+8593 on Windows, search for U+2191 in macOS's Character Viewer, use ↑ in HTML, or \2191 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. The code comes from the OEM console picture table, so the ↑ picture appears only when an OEM raster font is active; in a modern application using a TrueType font the same keystroke may insert nothing visible or a control character. HTML also defines the named entity ↑ for Upwards Arrow, but the numeric form ↑ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type upwards arrow on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 2 4 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Upwards Arrow character (↑) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type upwards arrow on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Upwards Arrow. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Upwards Arrow" and click the character to insert it.

How to use upwards arrow in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\2191"; ()
  • Python: \u2191 or chr(0x2191)
  • JavaScript: \u2191 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2191)
  • JSON: "\u2191"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Upwards Arrow?

The legacy Alt code for Upwards Arrow is 24. Hold Alt, type 2 4 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ↑ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ↑, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+8593 not work?

Alt+8593 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Upwards Arrow?

The Unicode codepoint for Upwards Arrow is U+2191. You can use this value in HTML as ↑, in CSS as \2191, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ↑ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+2191, then click it.
